gloss: end of a book; back matter; appendix section

definitions.gloss: end of a book; back of a volume; back matter
definitions.explanation: The final pages or section of a book or volume, where appendices, indexes, or afterwords are typically found.

examples.japanese: {巻末|かんまつ}に{索引|さくいん}がある。
examples.english: There is an index at the end of the book.

examples.japanese: {巻末|かんまつ}の{付録|ふろく}を{参照|さんしょう}してください。
examples.english: Please refer to the appendix at the back of the book.

examples.japanese: {巻末|かんまつ}には{著者|ちょしゃ}によるあとがきと{参考文献|さんこうぶんけん}リストが{掲載|けいさい}されている。
examples.english: The back of the book contains an afterword by the author and a bibliography.

notes:
Composed of {巻|かん} (volume, scroll) + {末|まつ} (end). Refers to the back portion of a book or publication where supplementary material is placed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巻末|かんまつ}の{付録|ふろく}: appendix at the end of a book
- {巻末|かんまつ}の{索引|さくいん}: index at the back
- {巻末|かんまつ}に{収録|しゅうろく}する: to include at the end of the volume
- {巻末|かんまつ}{資料|しりょう}: back-matter materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {巻頭|かんとう}: beginning of a book — the opposite of {巻末|かんまつ}
- {末尾|まつび}: the very end — more general; can refer to the end of any text or sequence
- あとがき: afterword — a specific type of content often found at the {巻末|かんまつ}
